thread:
maria-cs: heads-up — escalated ticket from Acadia Apps (acct ACD-112). They reported a clear behavior change after last nights rollout: assistant responses are more assertive and sometimes include incorrect factual claims. They also saw 500s for long prompts (~>2k tokens). passing to eng/ML for triage.

chandra-support: copy of the customer's initial report pasted below:
> we used to get careful hedging. since the new model it's answering as if it's certain and it's causing downstream product errors. also 2/5 requests returned 500s when prompt truncated. can you revert?

olivia-pm: timeline — canary deploy happened 2026-02-11 22:12 UTC (deploy-bot confirms). model variant: redwood-v3-alpha-20260211 with updated decoding defaults (temp 0.7, top_p 0.95) and a new safety-filter hook. Canary showed no blocking alerts, rolled to 40% at 02:10. First customer reports came in around 03:05.

deploy-bot: [deploy] redwood-v3-alpha-20260211 promoted to canary @ 2026-02-11T22:12:06Z

liam-eng: looking at SLOs — p99 latency jumped from 410ms to 820ms for this variant, CPU/mem on serving nodes stable. I see increased tail due to longer decode loops (more tokens), and a spike in error 500s that correlate with request length > 2k tokens. stack traces point to tokenization step sometimes throwing OutOfBounds in the new tokenizer module.

sanjay-ml: thanks @liam-eng — that matches an internal change: we rolled a new tokenizer split optimization to speed up batching. edge-case: split offsets differ when prompts include many non-ascii chars which can mis-index KV cache and lead to aborted shards. Also changed default temperature and top_p tuning which could make outputs less cautious.

maria-cs: customers asking for immediate mitigation + clear comms. what can be offered now (besides sorry)?

sanjay-ml: mitigation options (short term):
1) recommend pin to previous model: model=redwood-v2-stable-20260130 (no tokenizer change).
2) lower decoding randomness from client-side: temperature=0.0, top_p=0.6 as a quick fix to reduce assertive hallucinations.
3) enable safety_profile=high (server-side flag) — toggles post-generation filters we can run without model change.
4) for 500s: advise truncating prompts to < 2k tokens OR run token_count precheck using /v1/tokens endpoint.

liam-eng: can implement per-tenant model pinning quickly — route ACD-112 to v2-stable via a feature-flag (will take ~20min to roll). Also pushing a hotfix to tokenizer to reject malformed offsets instead of crashing (non-breaking patch) — deploy ETA 3h.

infra-oncall: verifying infra — no OOMs or kernel panics. The 500s are application errors from the tokenizer process. If we route the tenant to v2 we'll avoid the crash.

olivia-pm: customer comms draft (short update) — pls review: 

"Hi Acadia team — we’re sorry for the disruption. We’ve identified a change in our recent rollout that can cause more confident phrasing and rare errors on long prompts. We are routing your traffic to the previous stable model immediately and have temporary server-side filters enabled to reduce incorrect assertions. We will follow up with a timeline for a permanent fix. If you want to test the previous model now you can set model=redwood-v2-stable-20260130 in your requests. — Olivia, PM"

maria-cs: yes send that. include recommended client-side flags for immediate improvement: temperature=0.0, top_p=0.6, max_tokens=512. Also include a curl repro snippet for customers that want to validate: 

```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \\\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"model":"redwood-v2-stable-20260130","input":"<your prompt>","temperature":0.0,"top_p":0.6,"max_tokens":512}'
```

chandra-support: sent to Acadia at 2026-02-12T04:10Z. they replied: "thank you, pinning works and we see fewer assertive responses. still want to know ETA for full fix."

sanjay-ml: status update — we repro locally using their example prompt (heavy emoji + mixed UTF8). tokenizer patch prevents crash and preserves offsets; still running unit tests on batching. If tests pass I can ship the non-breaking patch and flip canary back to 100% with updated decoder defaults that match v2 cautiousness.

liam-eng: rolled tenant routing for ACD-112 to v2-stable. p50/p95/p99 for them now back to baseline. rolling the change took ~12 minutes.

deploy-bot: [rollback] feature-flag routing ACD-112 -> redwood-v2-stable-20260130 applied @ 2026-02-12T04:22:37Z

maria-cs: next steps for CS: follow up tomorrow with ETA, include note about safety filters and next release. chandra — pls schedule a sync with contact.

chandra-support: scheduled 1120 PST / 2026-02-12 for handoff call. will ask if they'd like a larger rollback while we test.

olivia-pm: long term actions assigned:
- ML: revert tokenizer change or produce deterministic patch + add mixed-unicode test corpus (owner: sanjay-ml)
- Runtime: add pre-tokenization sanity check and robust error metric to avoid silent crashes (owner: liam-eng)
- Product: review decoding default matrix to make sure new model defaults don't change perceived assistant tone without explicit opt-in (owner: olivia-pm)

sanjay-ml: ETA for patch and canary re-roll: ~3-6h if tests green. will post updates in this thread.

liam-eng: I'll add a temporary alert rule for tokenization exceptions to catch similar regressions in future.

maria-cs: thanks everyone. updating ticket with status + workaround steps. will post final resolution when patch is live. :thumbsup:

sanjay-ml: quick status — tests passed. starting hotfix deploy to canary shards now.

deploy-bot: [deploy] redwood-tokenizer-hotfix-20260212 -> canary @ 2026-02-12T06:50:02Z

maria-cs: sending a brief update to Acadia: "we're deploying a targeted fix to the tokenizer; we'll monitor your traffic and follow up once it's verified. thanks for patience."

infra-oncall: monitoring — canary tokenization exceptions dropped to zero on hotfix shards. no regressions on latency.

chandra-support: Acadia acknowledged and appreciates the quick turnaround. marking as escalating->monitoring.

maria-cs: closing loop for now. will reopen if anything new pops up.
